_doc: Real-model routing traces for cache-policy and expert-prediction experiments (docs/reassessment/research/R8, experiment E-traces). Read by scripts/traces/run_real_traces.sh in workflow traces-real (GitHub Actions has huggingface.co; the agent sandbox does not). Models are PROXIES for GLM-5.3-Flash / Qwen3.8-Flash-Next routing (same families, fine-grained MoE), not the target models; the target models do not fit a CI runner. file_regex picks one GGUF from the repo listing; the chosen file name, repo revision and sha256 are recorded in each model's MANIFEST.json.

models.name: qwen3-coder-30b-a3b
models.why: 128 routed experts, top-8, softmax router; coding model - closest public proxy for agentic code routing (Qwen family, like Qwen3.8-Flash-Next)

models.name: glm-4.7-flash
models.why: GLM family, sigmoid router with selection bias (noaux_tc, like GLM-5.3-Flash); llama.cpp arch deepseek2
